title: Terrain Print
description: *Terrain Print* is a **web tool that turns any area of the Moon, Mars or Earth into a 3D-printable model**: one tile, pieces that fit the printer bed, or a **jigsaw puzzle** in a frame.
I set the bar for the data: **real NASA, USGS and open elevation data**, read at the resolution the print can show, with a **sea level you can raise or lower** on Earth and Mars.
Every mesh is **checked to be watertight by tests written before the code**.
